summary.text: Son of Merops of Percote and co-captain beside Adrastus in the Catalogue of Ships — Homer and Apollodorus both name him Amphius, distinct from Amphius son of Selagus whom Ajax slew.

story.text: Homer sets Amphius beside Adrastus at the head of the allies from Adrasteia, Apaesus, Pityeia, and Tereia. Their father Merops, greatest of prophets, forbade them the war, yet black fate drew the brothers on.
In the eleventh book Diomedes slew the chariot-team and the two sons of Merops together when the Trojans had seized the best men of their host from the field.
